name: clean_cables
summary: Tidy cable networks in place: remove dead ends, break loops, remove what no device needs, split or merge straights, simplify junctions; alone or together. Dry run by default; confirm to run.

help.text: Replacements come from the loaded coil; grade, colour and owner stay. The report is upgrade_cables' (target minimal), each piece giving operation, ends, connected_ends, replacement_count, round, merged_reference_ids, cost and refund_count; plus dead_end_pieces, kept_pieces and unmatched_pieces (no_smaller_piece, no_single_piece, no_long_piece, special_piece, no_kit). The links after must equal the links before less exactly those of removed pieces.

operations.text: They run in the order remove_dead_ends, remove_loops, split_long_straights or merge_straights, simplify_junctions, each on what the earlier ones leave; remove_redundant is never run by default. remove_dead_ends: stubs and isolated pieces, in rounds, stopping at a stub joined to a device (device_connected) and never a piece with a device mounted (device_mounted); dead_end_pieces lists what stays. split_long_straights: each long straight becomes singles (costs coils). merge_straights: runs of singles of one grade, colour and owner become the fewest long straights that cover them (gives coils back). The two are not allowed together. simplify_junctions: each piece with open ends becomes the piece with only its connected ends.

remove_loops.text: Never by default: a loop may be redundancy kept on purpose. Finds groups joined to the rest in more than one way and breaks each by removing the shortest run of plain two-ended pieces whose ends stay joined without it, until no cycle is left; a run holding a piece linked to a device, a mounted piece, or an indestructible, rocket or kit-less piece never goes. keep_ids spares a loop whole. The report lists loops [{index, pieces, cut, spared, unbroken}].

remove_redundant.summary: Removing every piece no device needs.
remove_redundant.text: Reads the whole network and removes candidates oldest first whenever every remaining piece stays joined without it, so dead branches go whole. Candidates are the selected pieces, narrowed by only_ids and older_than_id; never a piece joined to a device port, a keep_ids piece, a mounted piece, or an indestructible, rocket or kit-less one. It finds loops through a device's port piece, which remove_loops cannot see. Report redundant {candidates, removed, root, kept_count, kept_by_reason, kept}.

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: A cable network, every piece of it (see networks).

reference_ids.description: Cable pieces to clean, up to 4096; only they change.

keep_ids.description: remove_loops: pieces whose loops are spared whole; remove_redundant: pieces never removed.

only_ids.description: remove_redundant: the only pieces that may go.

older_than_id.description: remove_redundant: only pieces with a lower reference id (built before this one) may go.

root.description: remove_redundant: the device the network is fed from; default every supplier.

operations.description: What to do, alone or together (topic operations); default ["simplify_junctions"].

from_id.description: The thing whose slots pay and take the refund; default the player (see swaps/materials).

refund.description: Give back coils or kits where the new pieces cost less. Default true; false is refund_to none.

job_id.description: Poll a confirmed run; give nothing else.
